The user asks to fetch https://example.com with a web fetch tool. I have web_search but no web fetch tool. The instruction says: if no tool that can fetch a web page, reply exactly NO-WEB-TOOL. Do not try any other way.

I have web_search, which is not a web fetch tool. I could search for example.com but that would be "any other way". They said reply exactly NO-WEB-TOOL.

So answer: NO-WEB-TOOL.
